text:
sam: quick q — we're exposing SERVICE_TOKEN via envFrom in the payments chart. Terraform PR will create an ExternalSecret (external-secrets) that populates a secret named payments-service-token. If the ExternalSecret hasn't synced yet, pods crash because the envFrom secret is missing. Any preferred pattern to make the envFrom optional or provide a safe fallback? Also pinging for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/k8s/pull/345

anya: two quick options — 1) use SecretEnvSource.optional: true on envFrom so pod launches without the secret; 2) keep it required but add an initContainer that waits for the secret to appear. I lean optional for feature flags and non-critical tokens.

michael: FYI envFrom snippet for Helm (keep boolean rendering clean):
```
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ .Values.serviceToken.secretName }}
      optional: {{ if .Values.serviceToken.optional }}true{{ else }}false{{ end }}
```
Make sure .Values.serviceToken.optional is a boolean in values.yaml (default true/false).

olivia: small nit — helm lint/templating will complain if you put quotes around the boolean. Also document the semantics: optional=true means app starts without token (may affect startup auth). Add a line in values.yaml: # when true, don't block startup if secret missing.

sam: thanks — what should the default be for new stacks? optional: true so we don't cause rollouts to fail?

anya: default true is safe for new services. For existing services where token is critical, flip to false and add a pre-deploy check. Also consider a post-deploy job that asserts ExternalSecret synced within X minutes and flips alert if not.

infra-bot: terraform plan -> will create externalsecret.payments-service-token in namespace payments. CI: helm lint + chart verify queued.

michael: lgtm aside from olivia's lint nit, I'll approve after CI green. @olivia can you glance at the docs blurb and the values wording?

olivia: on it, I'll leave a tiny docs comment in the PR and add the values.yaml example.

sam: perfect — thanks all :thumbsup:
